trap.label: rise ≠ raise
trap.why: Raise é transitivo (aumentar algo). Rise é intransitivo: o preço subiu sozinho.

fix.wrong: It is a problem very serious.
fix.right: It is a very serious problem.

fix.wrong: Although it is cheap, but it is poor.
fix.right: Although it is cheap, it is poor.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “The graph shows a fall.”
Reescreva no passado: “The study shows a link.”
Reescreva com in my opinion: “According to me, it is fair.”
rewrite.answer: In my opinion, it is fair.
